name: Creational, Structural, and Behavioral Design Patterns
subject: Object-Oriented Programming Systems

mcqs.question: Which design pattern allows algorithms to be swapped at runtime without changing the client class?
mcqs.explanation: The Strategy pattern encapsulates interchangeable algorithms behind a common interface, allowing clients to select or switch strategies dynamically.

mcqs.question: In C++11 and newer, why is Meyers’ Singleton thread-safe without requiring explicit mutex locking?
options: The OS kernel forces single-threaded execution for singletons
Static local variables are guaranteed by the C++11 standard to be initialized thread-safely
The compiler converts singletons into atomic pointers automatically
C++ does not support threads natively
mcqs.explanation: C++11 mandates that block-scope static variables are initialized exactly once in a thread-safe manner, with concurrent threads blocking until initialization finishes.
